verdict_rule: hyp_cells.verdict: design fold fixes the sign; confirm fold decides. CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE = confirm mean > 0, t >= 2, design mean > 0; FAILED_VARIANT = confirm mean <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE <= effect worth having; else CANNOT_DISTINGUISH. SE over date blocks, MDE = 2.8 SE.

cells.title: Rate shock lifts regional bank net interest margin
cells.refutation: No positive open-to-close drift for the regional bank basket versus market beta in confirm.
cells.separation_from_beta: Regional bank basket outperforms the broad market and large-cap banks after the shock.

cells.title: Yield spike lifts money-center banks next session
cells.refutation: If money-center bank basket shows no significant next-session abnormal return relative to vol-matched utilities, the hypothesis is refuted.
cells.separation_from_beta: Compare money-center bank basket's next-session return to its market-beta-adjusted return and to a vol-matched basket of utilities; effect should be present only for banks.

cells.title: Oil spike pressures airline stocks next session
cells.refutation: No negative open-to-close drift for airlines versus market beta in the confirm window.
cells.separation_from_beta: Airlines underperform the broad market and transport peers after the shock.
